## Load in the Data

```{r}
data <- read_delim("SEER_brain_full.txt", 
                    delim = "\t", 
                    escape_double = FALSE, 
                    trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
  clean_names() 
```

# Clean the data

```{r}
df_clean <- data

# names(df_clean) <- c(

# BASIC NUMERIC CLEANING

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    survival_months = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(survival_months)),
    time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode)),
    year_of_diagnosis = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year_of_diagnosis)),
    tumor_size_summary_2016 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tumor_size_summary_2016)),
    regional_nodes_examined_1988 =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(regional_nodes_examined_1988)),
    regional_nodes_positive_1988 =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(regional_nodes_positive_1988))
  )

# Clean missing
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # survival_months: 9999 means unknown
    survival_months = ifelse(survival_months >= 9999, NA, survival_months),

    # time_to_treatment: 999 means unknown
    time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode =
      na_if(time_from_diagnosis_to_treatment_in_days_recode, 999),

    # tumor_size_summary_2016 often uses 999 as unknown
    tumor_size_summary_2016 = na_if(tumor_size_summary_2016, 999),

    # nodes often use 99 as unknown
    regional_nodes_examined_1988 = na_if(regional_nodes_examined_1988, 99),
    regional_nodes_positive_1988 = na_if(regional_nodes_positive_1988, 99)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        race_recode_white_black_other,
        radiation_recode,
        rx_summ_surg_rad_seq,
        rx_summ_systemic_sur_seq_2007,
        reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery,
        diagnostic_confirmation,
        combined_summary_stage_with_expanded_regional_codes_2004,
        grade_clinical_2018,
        grade_pathological_2018,
        marital_status_at_diagnosis
      ),
      ~ na_if(., 9)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        brain_molecular_markers_2018,
        median_household_income_inflation_adj_to_2023,
        rural_urban_continuum_code
      ),
      ~ na_if(., 99)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    brain_molecular_markers_2018 = na_if(brain_molecular_markers_2018, 126)
  )

# Check with survival flag 
# SURVIVAL OUTCOME VARIABLES
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    time = survival_months,
    event = case_when(
      vital_status_recode_study_cutoff_used == 1 ~ 1,
      vital_status_recode_study_cutoff_used == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

        "15-19 years" = "4",
        "20-24 years" = "5",
        "25-29 years" = "6",
        "30-34 years" = "7",
        "35-39 years" = "8",
        "40-44 years" = "9",
        "45-49 years" = "10",
        "50-54 years" = "11",
        "55-59 years" = "12",
        "60-64 years" = "13",
        "65-69 years" = "14",
        "70-74 years" = "15",
        "75-79 years" = "16",
        "80-84 years" = "17",
        "85-89 years" = "18",

# Drop below 18
# DEMOGRAPHIC FACTORS
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    race_factor = factor(race_recode_white_black_other) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "White" = "1",

    sex_factor = factor(sex) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Male" = "1",
        "Female" = "2"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    marital_status_factor = factor(marital_status_at_diagnosis) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Single" = "1",
        "Married" = "2",
        "Separated" = "3",
        "Divorced" = "4",
        "Widowed" = "5",
        "Unmarried or Domestic Partner" = "6"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown")

# TREATMENT FACTORS

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    radiation_factor = factor(radiation_recode) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "None" = "0",
        "Beam Radiation" = "1",
        "Radioactive Implants" = "2",
        "Radioisotopes" = "5",
        "Refused" = "7",
        "Recommended, Unknown if Given" = "8"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    radiation_binary = case_when(
      radiation_recode == 1 ~ "Yes",
      radiation_recode %in% c(0, 2, 5, 7, 8) ~ "No/Other",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    radiation_binary = factor(radiation_binary,
                              levels = c("No/Other", "Yes", "Unknown")),

    chemo_factor = factor(chemotherapy_recode_yes_no_unk) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No/Unknown" = "0",
        "Yes" = "1"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    surgery_performed = case_when(
      reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery == 0 ~ "Surgery Performed",
      reason_no_cancer_directed_surgery %in% c(1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "No Surgery",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    surgery_performed = factor(
      surgery_performed,
      levels = c("Surgery Performed", "No Surgery", "Unknown")
    ),

    surgery_sequence_factor = factor(rx_summ_surg_rad_seq) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No Radiation and/or No Surgery" = "0",
        "Radiation Before Surgery" = "2",
        "Radiation After Surgery" = "3",
        "Intraoperative Radiation" = "4",
        "Intraoperative + Other Radiation" = "5",
        "Surgery Both Before and After Radiation" = "6"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    systemic_sequence_factor = factor(rx_summ_systemic_sur_seq_2007) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "No Systemic Therapy and/or No Surgery" = "0",
        "Systemic Therapy Before Surgery" = "2",
        "Systemic Therapy After Surgery" = "3",
        "Systemic Therapy Both Before and After Surgery" = "4"
      ) %>%
      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown")
  )


# TUMOR / DISEASE FACTORS

        "Parietal Lobe" = "713",

# GRADE
# Use pathological first, clinical if path missing

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    grade_combined_raw = coalesce(grade_pathological_2018, grade_clinical_2018),

    grade_factor = factor(grade_combined_raw) %>%
      fct_recode(
        "Grade I" = "1",
        "Grade II" = "2",
        "Grade III" = "3",
        "Grade IV" = "4",
        "Cell Type Not Determined, Not Stated or Not Applicable" = "9"

      fct_na_value_to_level(level = "Unknown"),

    grade_binary = case_when(
      grade_combined_raw %in% c(1, 2, 15) ~ "Low Grade",
      grade_combined_raw %in% c(3, 4, 16) ~ "High Grade",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    grade_binary = factor(grade_binary,
                          levels = c("Low Grade", "High Grade", "Unknown"))

df_clean <- df_clean %>%

        "Oligodendroglioma, Grade III, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted" = "7",
        "Medulloblastoma / Other" = "8",
        "Embryonal / Other" = "9",
        "Not Applicable" = "85",

      ) %>%

    molecular_collapsed = case_when(
```

## Create treatment intensity

```{r}
## create numeric treatment variables
df_ml <- df_ml %>%
  mutate(
    chemo_num = ifelse(chemo_factor == "Yes", 1, 0),
    radiation_num = ifelse(radiation_binary == "Yes", 1, 0),
    surgery_num = ifelse(surgery_performed == "Surgery Performed", 1, 0)
  )

## PCA for treatment intensity
treatment_matrix <- df_ml %>%
  select(chemo_num, radiation_num, surgery_num) %>%
  as.matrix()

pca_treat <- prcomp(treatment_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

summary(pca_treat)

## add treatment intensity score (PC1)
df_ml$treatment_intensity <- pca_treat$x[,1]

summary(df_ml$treatment_intensity)
```

# Define Model A vs B

```{r}
## Model A dataset (no biomarkers)
df_model_A <- df_ml %>%
  select(
    high_risk,
    age_recode_with_1_year_olds_and_90,
    sex_factor,
    race_factor,
    stage_binary,
    grade_binary,
    treatment_intensity
  ) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  droplevels()

## Model B dataset (WITH biomarkers)
df_model_B <- df_ml %>%
  select(
    high_risk,
    age_recode_with_1_year_olds_and_90,
    sex_factor,
    race_factor,
    stage_binary,
    grade_binary,
    treatment_intensity,
    molecular_collapsed
  ) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  droplevels()
```

## Create the split and CV

```{r}
# Data partition
set.seed(2)

# split Model A
split_A <- initial_split(df_model_A, prop = 0.8, strata = high_risk)

train_A <- training(split_A)
test_A  <- testing(split_A)

# split Model B
split_B <- initial_split(df_model_B, prop = 0.8, strata = high_risk)

train_B <- training(split_B)
test_B  <- testing(split_B)

# set up cross validation
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10,
                     summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
                     classProbs = TRUE)
```

# Elastic Net 

```{r}
# Model A
set.seed(2)

en.grid <- expand.grid(
  alpha = seq(0, 1, length = 11),
  lambda = exp(seq(-8, 1, length = 100))
)

en_A.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = train_A,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = en.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "ROC"
)

ggplot(en_A.fit, highlight = TRUE)

en_A.fit$bestTune
```

```{r}
# Model B
set.seed(2)

en_B.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = train_B,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = en.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "ROC"
)

ggplot(en_B.fit, highlight = TRUE)

en_B.fit$bestTune
```

```{r}
## test performance for Elastic Net / Ridge
en_A.prob <- predict(en_A.fit, newdata = test_A, type = "prob")[, "HighRisk"]
en_A.pred <- predict(en_A.fit, newdata = test_A)

confusionMatrix(en_A.pred, test_A$high_risk)

roc.en_A <- roc(test_A$high_risk, en_A.prob)
roc.en_A$auc

mean(en_A.pred != test_A$high_risk)


en_B.prob <- predict(en_B.fit, newdata = test_B, type = "prob")[, "HighRisk"]
en_B.pred <- predict(en_B.fit, newdata = test_B)

confusionMatrix(en_B.pred, test_B$high_risk)

roc.en_B <- roc(test_B$high_risk, en_B.prob)
roc.en_B$auc

mean(en_B.pred != test_B$high_risk)
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
# Model A
set.seed(2)

rf_A.grid <- expand.grid(
  mtry = 1:6,
  splitrule = "gini",
  min.node.size = 1:6
)

rf_A.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = train_A,
  method = "ranger",
  tuneGrid = rf_A.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  metric = "ROC",
  importance = "permutation"
)

rf_A.fit$bestTune
```


## Boosting

```{r}
set.seed(2)

gbm_A.grid <- expand.grid(
  n.trees = c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000),
  interaction.depth = 1:4,
  shrinkage = c(0.001, 0.003, 0.005, 0.01),
  n.minobsinnode = 10
)

# Model A
gbm_A.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = train_A,
  method = "gbm",
  tuneGrid = gbm_A.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  distribution = "bernoulli",
  metric = "ROC",
  verbose = FALSE
)

ggplot(gbm_A.fit, highlight = TRUE)

gbm_A.fit$bestTune
```

```{r}
# Model B
set.seed(2)

gbm_B.grid <- expand.grid(

  interaction.depth = 1:4,

)

gbm_B.fit <- train(
  high_risk ~ .,
  data = train_B,
  method = "gbm",

  trControl = ctrl,

)

gbm_B.fit$bestTune
```

## Compare all 3

```{r}
## compare all models
model_results <- data.frame(
  Approach = c(
    "Regularized Logistic Regression",
    "Regularized Logistic Regression",
    "Random Forest",
    "Random Forest",
    "Boosting",
    "Boosting"
  ),
  Model = c(
    "Model A: Clinical Only",
    "Model B: Clinical + Biomarkers",
    "Model A: Clinical Only",
    "Model B: Clinical + Biomarkers",
    "Model A: Clinical Only",
    "Model B: Clinical + Biomarkers"
  ),
  Test_AUC = c(
    as.numeric(roc.en_A$auc),
    as.numeric(roc.en_B$auc),
    as.numeric(roc.rf_A$auc),
    as.numeric(roc.rf_B$auc),
    as.numeric(roc.gbm_A$auc),
    as.numeric(roc.gbm_B$auc)
  ),
  Test_Error = c(
    mean(en_A.pred != test_A$high_risk),
    mean(en_B.pred != test_B$high_risk),
    mean(rf_A.pred != test_A$high_risk),
    mean(rf_B.pred != test_B$high_risk),
    mean(gbm_A.pred != test_A$high_risk),
    mean(gbm_B.pred != test_B$high_risk)
  )
)

model_results
```
